scope: Feishu native Unicode paste and exact histories at fixed Gamma:5; rendered rows may be virtualized; no whole-document or project acceptance inferred

cases.name: H07-full-CJK-block-100000-R1.json
assertions: fixed Gamma:5 source and trusted native paste shortcut
exact original Unicode clipboard payload retained
exact accepted Unicode result and redo, including normalization
Undo and final Undo restore full original semantic document
original outer block IDs restored despite offscreen rendering
empty title tree unchanged
exact trusted Undo Redo Undo
no rejection feedback runtime errors or overflow
